request.prompt:
Create one complete high-impact vertical9:16 YouTube Shorts thumbnail,
preferably2160×3840, in the detailed cinematic illustrated ChronoStick world.
The first reference controls the detached ivory Guy Fawkes-style mask and its
simple charcoal-cuffed hand; the second controls historical Fawkes, closed
powder barrels and stone cellar. Preserve the specific identities and black
stick eyes. All subjects, hands, clothing, barrels and architecture are
illustrated in this same world, never photoreal people.

Tell a clear origin mystery in one glance. A large detached rigid ivory mask
dominates the lower-left/middle foreground, taking roughly55% of frame width
and half its height. Its black fixed eye openings, arched eyebrows, curved
moustache, pointed painted goatee and rose cheeks are recognizable. One
simplified charcoal-cuffed hand grips the lower-left edge. Keep the mask
fully readable and distinct from the smaller historical scene. In the right
background below the headline, show historical Fawkes from head to knees
beside intact closed wooden barrels under a stone arch. Preserve broad dark
felt hat, wavy brown hair, moustache and pointed beard, pale collar, brown
doublet and cloak. His watchful stick-face expression is visible. He never
wears or holds the modern mask. Use believable depth and strong scale
separation for this conceptual symbol/history juxtaposition, not divided
panels. Do not let the large mask cover his face.

Use warm amber side-lighting on Fawkes and barrels, restrained cool rim light
on the foreground ivory mask, and a simple dark blue-charcoal stone background.
Clear silhouettes, beautiful rich textures, high contrast and mobile-readable
hierarchy. Mood: urgent intriguing historical mystery. No explosion, no fire,
no spark, no lit fuse, no glowing powder, no gore, no additional person.

Generate this EXACT Spanish headline in the artwork in the same pass:
first line "¿DE DÓNDE", second line "SALIÓ?". No other text. Very-heavy rounded
uppercase display letters, broad counters and compact spacing, thick near-black
outline, shallow bevel/extrusion and soft shadow. First line warm white,
second line bright yellow-to-gold. Preserve the inverted question mark and
both accent marks. Place this two-line headline in the upper area with the
topmost visible lettering pixel INCLUDING accents, punctuation, stroke,
bevel and shadow starting approximately15% below the full image top edge,
NEVER above12%. Keep generous side margins. At2160×3840 aim for576px inset,
minimum461px. The entire headline is clearly separated from both faces and
the barrels. Do not add any logos, watermarks, dates, labels or other lettering.
One finished complete illustration with integrated headline, no later overlay.
